scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Korn shell integer loop
checks.code: integer total=0; for ((i=1;i<=10;i++)); do ((total+=i)); done; print -r -- "$total"

checks.name: Korn shell multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: for n in 1 2; do IFS= read -r line; print -r -- "[$line]"; done

checks.name: Korn shell handled failure follows native status
